caption: The drawing consists of a detailed colored depiction of a single right shoe and two simple outline sketches of shoes viewed from above. The main shoe is shown in a side profile facing right and is predominantly black with a slight glossy appearance. It features a low, curved heel and an almond-shaped toe. The upper edge of the shoe is trimmed with a bright pink band that outlines the shoe's opening, and there is a small blue decorative element, possibly a buckle or strap, at the front center near the top edge. The sole of the shoe is brown and visible at the front and back. In the upper left corner, there are two outline sketches: both show a shoe from a top-down view, one with a simple rectangular element at the toe and the other with a plain vamp and visible inner stitching. In the lower left corner, there is a circular stamp with text inside. The background of the image is a plain light beige color.
title: Woman's Slippers
